title: TUI answers can file an adj ask and decide
lead: Owner decision #45: an optional toggle files the owner's answer as an adj ask plus decide. The recording must use decide --by jon, and only from the owner's answer in the TUI. Depends on the answer pane slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision #45: an optional toggle files the owner's answer as an adj ask plus decide. The recording must use decide --by jon, and only from the owner's answer in the TUI. Depends on the answer pane slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/tui (toggle), internal/daemon or cli (the adj calls), tests, docs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- With the toggle on, an answer runs adj ask and adj decide --by jon with the shown key and text; the commands are displayed first.
- With the toggle off, nothing is recorded in adj.
- An adj error shows verbatim and does not lose the answer.
